primary.title: Learn to build better AI Agents through better context
primary.summary: Learn More: https://bit.ly/4yy5iWP The longer an agent works, the more repeated, contradictory, or stale information builds up in its context. Models perform worse as their context grows, a problem Jeff Huber and his team at Chroma named Context Rot. In our new course, Context Engineering, taught by Jeff Huber alongside guest speaker Drew Breunig, you'll build agent harnesses from scratch in Python and learn to give agents the right information, in the right format, at the right time. In this course, you'll learn: - Agentic search: Retrieve data with multiple search tools from different source

primary.summary: Pi Durable is a building block for always-on agent applications, not a new coding-agent CLI. Learn how checkpoints, conversations, and storage support recovery after interruptions, where Durable fits in the Pi ecosystem, and the six steps to initialize a harness. Then follow a local llama.cpp demo with Qwen3.5-0.8B, including a second script that resumes interrupted work from SQLite.
